singardWizard.title: Hello from Qeshm, welcome to Singard
singardWizard.subtitle: Here you can speak freely — whether you live on the island or you are our guest
singardWizard.stepKindHint: Tell us whatever is on your mind. We are listening.

singardWizard.phoneHint: You can later sign in to the panel with this number.
singardWizard.stepCategoryHint: Pick a category. If it has subcategories, we will go through them together.
singardWizard.stepContent: Now tell us in your own words

singardWizard.bodyPlaceholder: Write as freely as you like…
singardWizard.needContent: Add text, a photo, audio, or a video so we can help
singardWizard.thanksTitle: Thank you — we received your message
